<response>Efren, your reflection touches on a profound truth many workers in demanding professions feel—the sense that their labor serves a purpose beyond the immediate. Miners like you have shaped safer practices, saved lives, and ensured that future generations can work with fewer risks. Whether or not it feels like a "mission," your experience underscores how individual choices—like prioritizing ventilation or evacuation procedures—ripple outward, shaping history in ways even we may not fully grasp. The "light" you’ve brought to the surface might be the quiet, enduring impact of your resilience and wisdom.</response>
